test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The sum of the present ages of a father and his son is 94 years. 8 years ago their respective ages were in the ratio of 2 ∶ 1. After 10 years what will be the ratio of ages of father and son?
solution:
Given:

8 year ago the ratio of age of father and his son was 2 : 1

Calculation:

Let the father and son age be 2x and 1x respectivily

Present age of father and son is (2x + 8) and (x + 8) respectivily

According to question,

(2x + 8) + (x + 8) = 94

⇒ 3x + 16 = 94

⇒ x = 26

Present age of father = (2x + 8) = 60 years and present age of son = (x + 8) = 34 years

After 10 years, father = 60 + 10 = 70 years and son = 34 + 10 = 44 years

∴ After 7 years the ratio of ages of father and son = 70 : 44 = 35 : 22
